about: Blind text judge labels per unique sentence (normalized text) of the 200 set and the open sets: best genre (or none = no game in the sentence) and 1-3 acceptable genres out of 24 (19 current + survivor, hole, steal, sort, arrows). Frozen before P66 changes the classifier.
judge: claude-opus-5-5 (claude -p --safe-mode --tools "" in an empty mkdtemp; sees only numbered sentences and the 24 plain-word type descriptions under keys G01-G24)
generator: pure-rand xoroshiro128plus + uniformInt, Fisher-Yates: first the G-key order of the 24 types, then the sentence order; batches = consecutive 20

descriptions.runner: Endless run: the hero runs forward on its own down a track, street or slope (also skiing, skating, surfing, sledding), switching lanes and jumping or sliding to dodge obstacles while picking things up on the way.
descriptions.platformer: Platform jumping: the hero runs and jumps from ledge to ledge over gaps and climbs upward, side view, to reach the end of the level.
descriptions.arena: Open-area roaming seen from above: the hero moves freely around one place to gather scattered things, to run away from chasers, or to brawl with several opponents.
descriptions.voyage: Steering a craft: sail, fly, drive or ride a ship, plane, car, broom or rocket along a course between obstacles to a destination, or bring a craft down for a soft landing.
descriptions.quest: Doing a job on objects: go to things in a place and act on each one – light, put out, cook, flip, repair, free, water, paint – often while something chases you, or work a station like a stove before orders pile up.
descriptions.shooter: Aim and shoot: point at targets or enemies that come at you and shoot them down, like a shooting gallery or a wave of attackers.
descriptions.throw: Throwing at a target: aim and throw, toss or launch something (a ball into a hoop, a golf shot, a slingshot or catapult, bowling) to hit a goal.
descriptions.timing: One-tap timing: something swings back and forth and a single tap stops it at the right moment – dropping blocks onto a growing tower, stopping a needle on a mark, laying a plank across a gap.
descriptions.rhythm: Rhythm: tap in time with the beats of the music as notes arrive (drums, dancing, piano).
descriptions.duel: One-on-one duel: face a single opponent at a time, dodge when they wind up and strike back in the opening – a showdown or a fight against a rival.
descriptions.flap: Flapping flight: every tap gives a small lift; keep the flyer in the air and steer it through gaps between obstacles.
descriptions.catch: Catching what falls: slide left and right along the bottom to catch things falling from above and let the dangerous ones pass.
descriptions.whack: Whack the pop-ups: things pop out of holes or hiding spots for a moment and you hit them before they disappear again.
descriptions.defense: Lane defense: waves of enemies march down lanes toward your base or wall and you shoot them before they reach it.
descriptions.slice: Slicing: things are tossed up into the air and you swipe to cut them, leaving the bombs alone.
descriptions.hop: Road crossing: hop forward step by step across lanes of traffic, rivers or rails to reach the far side without getting hit.
descriptions.crowd: Growing crowd: run through gates that multiply or shrink a crowd of followers, dodge what thins it out, and throw the whole crowd at a big boss at the end.
descriptions.merge: Drop and merge: drop things into a container where two identical ones combine into a bigger one; keep the heap from reaching the top.
descriptions.push: Push out of the ring: shove rivals off a platform or out of a ring while staying on it yourself.
descriptions.survivor: Survive the horde: move the hero around with a stick while it attacks automatically; ever larger swarms close in, between waves you pick one of three upgrades, and a big boss comes at the end.
descriptions.hole: Growing hole: steer a hole in the ground around a place (a city, a farm, a kitchen); it swallows everything smaller than itself and grows, so bigger and bigger things fit in.
descriptions.steal: Grab and run: get into someone else's place, grab a valuable thing and carry it back to your own base while guards chase you; upgrades between rounds.
descriptions.sort: Sorting: tap to move items or colours between containers – tubes, shelves, boxes, cars – until every container holds just one kind; short puzzle rounds.
descriptions.arrows: Tap-away puzzle: a tight pack of pieces each pointing one way; a tapped piece slides off in its direction only if its path is clear, so you clear the board in the right order.
